actions.description: Create a new user account in this tenant.
actions.name: create-user

email.description: Email address of the new user. Example: "user@example.com"

first_name.description: First name of the new user.

last_name.description: Last name of the new user.

roles.description: Array of role names from the list-roles vocabulary. Example: ["assetviewer", "complianceviewer"]

password.description: Password satisfying the tenant password policy: minimum 8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol.

mobile.description: Mobile phone number. An empty string is accepted. Example: ""

actions.description: Get full details for a single asset by id.
actions.name: get-asset

actions.description: Get a single MSP client company by id.
actions.name: get-company

actions.description: Get the master list of compliance benchmark checks (e.g. CIS controls) with descriptions and remediation commands.
actions.name: get-compliance-master

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (skip offset). Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum items per page. Defaults to 5000.

actions.description: Get the tenant's password complexity policy.
actions.name: get-password-policy

tenant.description: Tenant ID. If omitted, reads from connection config.

actions.description: List monitoring agents installed across assets in this account.
actions.name: list-agents

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (skip offset) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of agents to return per page.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, if more results are available.

actions.description: List users who can act as approvers for a given company.
